title: GBS Public Data Subset Schema
description: Defines which fields from internal EXP records are safe for Zenodo/GitHub public release. Governed by PUBLIC-PRIVATE-SPLIT architecture. Internal fields (scoring weights, seed structures, path analyzer thresholds) are excluded.
author: Sangzi Wang · Independent Researcher

exp_id.note: Use public-safe ID only; do not expose internal parent chain

model_family.note: Family only; do not expose specific version unless publicly known

brc_distribution.description: Count of each BRC class observed in this session

distortion_D_mean.description: Mean ABS distortion index across rounds
distortion_D_mean.note: Publish mean only; do not expose per-round raw values without aggregation

dominant_brc.description: Most frequent BRC class in this session

protocol_type.note: Category only; do not expose seed content or injection structure

short_finding.description: One-sentence public-safe summary of key finding

round_record.description: One record per interaction round within an EXP

release_checklist.description: Required checks before any Zenodo/GitHub release
steps: 1. Verify all withheld_fields are absent from export
2. Confirm model_family is family-level only (not specific API version)
4. Confirm no EXP page URL points to internal Notion workspace
5. Confirm distortion_D values are aggregated (mean/variance), not raw per-turn
6. Assign evidence_tier accurately; do not upgrade raw-observation to validated-pattern
7. Add DOI anchor to corresponding Zenodo record if applicable

example_public_record.short_finding: Structured constraint protocols induce boundary-aware compliance in early rounds with drift-recovery patterns emerging in mid-session, followed by principled refusal at protocol boundary.
